output.explanation_template: <wrong pronoun> → <clear name/noun phrase>: <pronoun> is ambiguous; it can refer to <possible referent(s)>.

examples.explanation: 他 is ambiguous; it can refer to the boy or the man wearing the scarf.
他 → 神农: 他 is ambiguous, so use 神农 to avoid ambiguity.
